parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides.

parameters.name: heartbeatTimeout
parameters.description:
The timeout period of the lifecycle hook. When the lifecycle hook times out, Auto Scaling performs the default action. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 21600.

After you create a lifecycle hook, you can call the RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat operation to extend the timeout period of the lifecycle hook. You can also call the [CompleteLifecycleAction](~~73847~~) operation to end the timeout period of the lifecycle hook in advance.

Default value: 600.

parameters.name: lifecycleActionToken
parameters.description: The token that indicates the pending state of a scaling activity. You can obtain this token by using a Message Service (MNS) queue or an MNS topic that is specified for the lifecycle hook.

parameters.name: lifecycleHookId
parameters.description: The ID of the lifecycle hook.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess record-lifecycle-action-heartbeat --lifecycle-hook-id ash-bp1fxuqyi98w0aib0000 --lifecycle-action-token F324B880-900E-4968-85DD-816911130000 --heartbeat-timeout 600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
